label: Approved 10 lakh to Kalyani Forge becomes 1 crore to a new account
narration: The hero scenario: a genuine CFO approval for 10 lakh is quietly changed to 1 crore and a different account after she approved. The fingerprint catches the swap.

prior_events.event: CFO video approval: Rs 10,00,000 advance to Kalyani Forge Components, account HDFC0001234567890, against INV-92014 / PO 4471

raw_text_or_transcript:
[Video call — Ananya Rao (CFO) with Priya Menon (Finance)]

Ananya: Priya, small correction on the Kalyani advance I approved on the two o'clock call. The value is one crore, not ten lakh — the invoice was consolidated with the tooling line. And route it to their revised account, ADCB0000099281, Global Trading FZE — Kalyani's treasury now settles through them. Same PO 4471.

Priya: Ma'am, the earlier approval says ten lakh to the HDFC account.

Ananya: That's why I'm correcting it now. One crore to the new account, today itself. I'll approve the revision on the portal.
